# Letters to the East

*Odda writes to an old friend in Fairy Forest each spring, and the letters go east along the Northern Woodland Trail. Hunt 40 Edge Lizards in the Edgewood so they get there.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md) |
| Level | 17 |
| Leads to | [Spring Letters](../quests/odda_spring_letters.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Edge Lizard](../monsters/edge_lizard.md) in [The Edgewood](../maps/edgewood.md)

## Rewards

- 2,200 EXP
- 340 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Odda](../npcs/odda_brenna.md)
